verdicts.reason: A rebuilds the layout for the tall canvas. It moves the headline up under the logo, gives the can and a large CTA clear zones and fills the height. Its flaws: the sticker placeholder is shrunk into a meaningless chip at the bottom, and the legal line is microscopic and pushed left, off the centred axis. B is just a shrunk copy of the original packed into the middle band, leaving large empty areas above the logo and below the legal line. Its can, CTA and legal text are undersized, the legal text is nearly unreadable, and the sticker floats loose to the right.
